snippet.title: VeggieTales - Donut Hockey
snippet.description:
Hey everyone! trackmaniamatt here with a brand new video!

To start this off, Happy Easter to those of my viewers who celebrate it!

This video showcases my gameplay of the VeggieTales game, titled "Donut Hockey", which takes place after the events of the episode, "The End of Silliness". This game is a bit tricky, as the player is controlling Larry the Cucumber with only the computer mouse. 

I ended up losing on my first attempt in this recording, and used a clip from a JonTron episode to express my frustration, before doing my second attempt. I eventually won with my second attempt, so that's a plus!

There are plenty of more video to come. And, as always, Enjoy!

Credit goes to to Let's Player Moments for the JonTron clip.
Clip link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0_DCs29xw2A
